Chapter 262: Chapter 12: Jun Wuji, I Know Your Big Secret (4700 words, please subscribe)_3

Lin Yuan’s expression held a tinge of regret.

He had originally planned to sell this Divine Skill to the Goddess of Wisdom, but it now seemed unfeasible.

Although Lin Yuan felt some disappointment, he quickly adjusted his mindset.

The higher the level and the more powerful the Divine Gift, the greater its restrictions.

In the Main World Universe Starry Sky, some special Secret Technique heritages possess ‘uniqueness’.

That is to say, in the same era, only one life can master this kind of Secret Technique heritage.

...

This is an ironclad rule of the Main World, even if you have fully comprehended the Secret Technique heritage, you still cannot use it.

…

Blood Demon Sea.

The Blood Demon Master sat on an island deep within.

“After more than a hundred thousand years, I can finally stir up a great war in the Central Divine Continent again.”

The Blood Demon Master’s expression was one of excitement.

One hundred and twenty thousand years ago, he had instigated a great war in the Central Divine Continent alongside the Demon Saint’s Nest and Nether Palace.

However, he was utterly defeated at the time and had only just recovered over the past few thousand years.

“Daode Immortal Sect occupying the ‘Ascension Platform’ has forced us to remain in this realm…”

The Blood Demon Master muttered to himself.

“Master.”

At this moment, a blood-colored figure condensed above the Blood Demon Sea and bowed towards the Blood Demon Master.

“The Central Divine Continent is filled with formations laid by the Daode Immortal Sect. If we want to enter the Central Divine Continent with minimal losses, we need to ascertain the specific locations of these formations and other details…”

The blood-colored figure spoke softly.

“What is your plan?”

The Blood Demon Master went straight to the point.

“There are not many in the Daode Immortal Sect who are privy to these formations, one of them being Jun Dongjin…”

The blood-colored figure implied meaningfully.

It has been no secret that Jun Dongjin was assigned to Vast Cliff Mountain over the last century.

The next Sect Master of the Daode Immortal Sect was almost certainly going to be Mu Mengting.

Jun Dongjin had already become an expendable piece for the Daode Immortal Sect.

“Subordinates believe that Jun Dongjin can be won over… If he can be made to serve us, invading the Central Divine Continent would be much easier…..”

The blood-colored figure continued.

“Indeed.”

The Blood Demon Master nodded slightly.

He could guess that Jun Dongjin probably harbored deep resentment towards the Daode Immortal Sect.

Now was the right time to win him over.

“But one thing must be kept in mind.”

“Jun Dongjin cannot be directly won over.”

“Surely the Daode Immortal Sect has laid plans near Vast Cliff Mountain.”

The Blood Demon Master spoke up.

“So the master wants to…”

The blood-colored figure inquired softly.

“Approach Jun Dongjin’s young son, Jun Wuji.”

“Then, through Jun Wuji, we can lure Jun Dongjin without fail and avoid the detection of any abnormalities by the Daode Immortal Sect.”

The Blood Demon Master put forth.

“Master is wise.”

The blood-colored figure, after pondering for a moment, was filled with admiration.

Directly winning over Jun Dongjin indeed bore great risks.

Jun Dongjin, having once been a high-ranking official of the Daode Immortal Sect, would undoubtedly still be protected by many means, even though he was no longer in favor.

By attempting to win over Jun Dongjin, they would essentially be informing the Daode Immortal Sect of their intentions.

On the contrary, Jun Dongjin’s son, Wuji, held much less prominence.

Moreover, Cloud Mist Blessed Land was located right next to the Daode Immortal Sect. ‘Hidden in plain sight’ applied here; it was likely that the Daode Immortal Sect would never suspect their interest in Wuji.

“Remember.”

“When dealing with Jun Wuji, never use force. We must threaten or promise great wealth.”

The Blood Demon Master reminded.

At the same time, he opened his palm and a blood-red crystal appeared.

“Carrying this object will allow you to temporarily evade the surveillance of the Taihao Immortal Mirror.”

The Blood Demon Master declared.

After fighting with the Daode Immortal Sect numerous times over hundreds of thousands of years.

The Blood Demon Master had naturally accumulated some measures against the Daode Immortal Sect.

Especially that Taihao Immortal Mirror.

However.

The means of evading the Taihao Immortal Mirror’s surveillance came at a great cost to the Blood Demon Master.

And there were numerous limitations.

It couldn’t be widely disseminated.

…

Cloud Mist Blessed Land.

At the top of the mountain, within a pavilion.

Lin Yuan lay in a chaise lounge, leisurely basking in the sun.

“You may leave.”

Lin Yuan waved his hand.

“Yes.”

Chunhua and Qiuyue bowed and exited.

Time passed unknowingly.

In the shadow of the pavilion, a blood-colored figure appeared soundlessly.

“Jun Wuji.”

The blood-colored figure approached Lin Yuan, voice hoarse and deep.

“I know your great secret.”

The blood-colored figure gazed at Jun Wuji intently.

“Great secret?”

Lin Yuan was momentarily startled.

He had already detected the presence of the blood-colored figure.

The ability to infiltrate Central Divine Continent and Cloud Mist Blessed Land came from a special aura exuding from the figure’s body.

Originally, Lin Yuan wanted to see if the blood-colored figure’s intrusion was due to a specific matter.

But hearing the figure openly claim to know his great secret, he couldn’t help but be surprised.

“Great secret…”

“Which great secret do you refer to?”

Lin Yuan asked solemnly.

“Which great secret?”

The blood-colored figure was somewhat confused.

Could it be that this Jun Wuji had many secrets? And they had to ask about which great secret?
